text.title: Talking about the countryside
text.body_text: Georgie and Neil have a real conversation in easy English about weddings – he countryside – the area outside the cities, where there are more green spaces, plants and wildlife.…
text.summary: Georgie and Neil have a real conversation in easy English about the countryside – the area outside the cities, where there are more green spaces, plants and wildlife. Learn which word describes somewhere that is full of green, healthy plants and find out Neil and Georgie's favourite countryside locations in the UK.
